instructions: This package contains core domain types, schemas, and Effect workflows for CREED OS. Invariants: 1) Strict Schema & Type safety using Zod and Effect/Schema, 2) Immutable data models, 3) DPDP compliant parental consent state machine transitions.

rules.rule: Parental consent state machine transitions must be strictly enforced. A state may only advance through valid edges: PENDING_PARENTAL_NOTICE -> NOTICE_SENT -> VERIFIED_ACTIVE, with explicit transitions to WITHDRAWN and EXPIRED. Never bypass state validation.
All Effect domain services and workflow pipelines must use Data.TaggedError for failure cases. Never return un-tagged or untyped Error instances.
All domain boundary inputs must be validated with Zod schemas before being processed or passed to workflows.
